name: Raspberry Pi 400 Keyboard
notes: 65-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Raspberry Pi 400 Keyboard, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/Gadgetoid/pi400kb/issues/7. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
